entry.description: Find where variation is handled and design a jointly workable social and technical arrangement. A basic primary-work-system exercise informed by the socio-technical tradition. It is not a complete participative design process or a substitute for workers' and users' involvement.

key_distinctions: Mechanical correctness is distinct from judgement in an open situation.
Training-case application is distinct from competent organisational practice.
practice_connections: Define the primary task and the social and technical arrangements.
Locate a significant variance and where it is currently controlled.
Design a joint change with minimum necessary constraints.
